headline: 24 medical students injured as bus falls into ditch in Comilla
summary: Students from Sher-e-Bangla Medical College were traveling to Cox's Bazar for a study tour when the accident occurred in Daudkandi.
details: A bus carrying students from Sher-e-Bangla Medical College was involved in an accident in the Jinglatoli area of Daudkandi, Comilla, on Tuesday morning.
The accident occurred around 4:30 AM when the bus fell into a ditch while the students were on their way to Cox's Bazar for a study tour.
According to Dr. Nayan De of the Daudkandi Upazila Health Complex, 24 students were injured in the crash, with nine of them in critical condition.
The critically injured students have been shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Highway police arrived quickly at the scene to rescue the passengers from the wreckage.
Daudkandi Highway Police Station OC Prem Das stated that the driver and the assistant driver fled the scene immediately after the accident.
caption:
24 medical students injured in Comilla after their bus plunged into a ditch during a study tour.

A bus carrying students from Sher-e-Bangla Medical College was involved in an accident in the Jinglatoli area of Daudkandi, Comilla, on Tuesday morning.

The accident occurred around 4:30 AM when the bus fell into a ditch while the students were on their way to Cox's Bazar for a study tour.

According to Dr. Nayan De of the Daudkandi Upazila Health Complex, 24 students were injured in the crash, with nine of them in critical condition.

The critically injured students have been shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.

Highway police arrived quickly at the scene to rescue the passengers from the wreckage.

Daudkandi Highway Police Station OC Prem Das stated that the driver and the assistant driver fled the scene immediately after the accident.

headline_marked: Govt says [[attack on actress Ajmeri Haq Badhon in Italy]] is proof she was on right path
headline: Govt says attack on actress Ajmeri Haq Badhon in Italy is proof she was on right path
summary: Information Advisor Zahed Ur Rahman says the government will not let the incident go unpunished and calls the attackers a 'mafia gang'.
details: Actress Ajmeri Haq Badhon reported being physically assaulted and harassed in Mestre, Italy, while visiting for the 83rd Venice International Film Festival.
Badhon alleged that attackers threw water, soft drinks, and eggs at her and forced her to chant 'Joy Bangla, Joy Bangabandhu' while filming the incident for social media.
The actress claimed the attack was targeted because of her active role in the 2024 student-led mass uprising in Bangladesh.
Information Advisor Zahed Ur Rahman stated at a press conference that being a victim of harassment by a 'mafia gang' like the Awami League proves Badhon was on the right path.
The Advisor added that the government is initiating legal action in Italy and will not let the incident go unpunished.
Zahed Ur Rahman further questioned whether the Awami League should be allowed to practice politics on Bangladeshi soil given their actions.
The Milan Consulate has reportedly offered all types of assistance to Badhon following the attack.
Badhon is currently in Italy for the screening of the movie 'The Difficult Bride', directed by Rubaiyat Hossain.
